items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: When I first joined the band at Disneyland... I asked Al Grey... Al say, '2-4-81'

ctx.x: When I first joined, and this is the truth, you can ask Al Grey about this, right? He was here earlier, you can ask him about this. When I first joined the band at Disneyland, I showed up and they had this book there, and I’m acting like I knew what I was doing, then so the band hits, Count Basie’s like doodling as he always did, and by the way, they could tell what was coming up by the way he was doodling. So it’d be new. So I asked Al Grey, “What number?” Al say, “2-4-81” and another guy said, “5-90” and…
So that was your audition almost? Trial by fire, huh?
